name: Tellico River Corridor Dispersed Camping - Cherokee National Forest

management_agency.name: U.S. Forest Service - Tellico Ranger District

rules_and_regulations.cost: 100% Free - No fees, no permits required for general dispersed primitive camping outside developed fee campgrounds
rules_and_regulations.stay_limit: 14 consecutive days max stay within 30-day period
rules_and_regulations.guidelines: Dispersed primitive camping permitted on general national forest lands along Tellico River Road (FS 210) and side forest service roads. Must be set back 100ft from water bodies.

waste_disposal_rules.poop_disposal: Cathole method: dig 6-8 inches deep in organic soil, at least 200 feet from Tellico River. Pack out toilet paper.
waste_disposal_rules.trash_policy: Strict Leave No Trace pack-it-in pack-it-out. Black bears active: bear canister or vehicle storage mandatory.

campfire_rules.firewood_policy: Gather dead and downed wood only within forest.
campfire_rules.safety_requirements: Campfires in established rock fire rings only. Extinguish cold to touch with river water.
campfire_rules.seasonal_fire_bans: Obey Tennessee Division of Forestry burn bans during dry spring/autumn.

access_and_road_conditions.road_type: Paved scenic road changing to unpaved gravel forest road (FS 210 / Tellico River Road)
access_and_road_conditions.road_conditions: Paved main road along river; gravel side forest roads have small washboards and dips.
access_and_road_conditions.vehicle_recommendation: Normal low clearance front wheel drive car (easily accessible along main river road in dry weather)

nomad_connectivity_rating.verizon_reliability: 2-3 bars 4G LTE on higher turnouts; spotty down near river gorge
nomad_connectivity_rating.terrain_obstruction_risk: Moderate (Southern Appalachian mountain ridges restrict cell signal)

seasonal_weather_effects.spring: 60-75°F, high river waterfall flow, blooming mountain laurel, spring rainstorms.
seasonal_weather_effects.summer: 75-85°F, pleasant mountain temperature, river swimming holes, shaded canopy.
seasonal_weather_effects.fall: Spectacular Appalachian autumn foliage (55-70°F daytime, 35-45°F nights), prime camping.
seasonal_weather_effects.winter: Cool 35-50°F, freezing nights, occasional mountain snow dustings.

dangers_and_hazards: Black Bears active in Cherokee NF - store food securely
Copperheads and Timber Rattlesnakes near rocky outcrops
High river currents after heavy mountain rain

common_human_made_sounds: Occasional fly angler truck on river road

human_demographics_and_culture: Fly anglers, Cherohala Skyway motorcycle tourists, backcountry backpackers, and digital nomads.

spiritual_and_folklore_data.nature_spirits_and_mythological_lore: Cherokee indigenous traditions revere the Tellico River valley as sacred ancestral fishing grounds guarded by river spirits.
spiritual_and_folklore_data.energetic_and_spiritual_features: Flowing mountain river energy, ancient Southern Appalachian forest peace, clean mountain air.

nearby_hiking_trails.features: Winding trail along 90-foot cascading waterfall gorge

public_reviews_summary: Beautiful primitive camping along the famous Tellico River in East Tennessee. Great trout fishing, scenic waterfalls, and solid cell service.
other_data: Bortle Class 3 night sky. Abundant firewood.
